The 74HC1G04GW is a single-gate CMOS logic inverter , designed for applications requiring a compact and low-power digital NOT gate. It operates from a wide 2.0 V to 6.0 V supply range and uses CMOS input switching levels.

The device provides one independent inverter in a compact 5-pin TSSOP package (SOT353-1), making it suitable for logic-level conversion, signal inversion, clock conditioning, and general-purpose digital circuits.
Wide supply voltage: 2.0 V to 6.0 V
Nexperia specifies the 74HC1G04GW for 2.0–6.0 V operation, with a typical maximum operating frequency of 36 MHz and ±2.6 mA output drive capability.
Propagation delay: approximately 23 ns maximum at 6 V with 50 pF load
Suitable for digital signal inversion and moderate-speed logic applications.
Operates directly from a 2.0–6.0 V DC supply.
Suitable for 3.3 V and 5 V digital logic systems.
Place a suitable bypass capacitor close to the VCC and GND pins when designing the circuit.
74HC1G04GW uses CMOS input switching levels. Do not confuse it with 74HCT1G04GW, which uses TTL-compatible input levels and has a different supply-voltage specification.
The GW suffix is TSSOP-5 / SOT353-1, not the SOT23-5 package designation. Nexperia lists the GV variant as TSOP5/SOT753.
This device is not a Schmitt-trigger inverter; for hysteresis applications, use an appropriate Schmitt-trigger logic device such as the 74HC1G14

blocks.text: Development board for theCH554G low-cost 8-bit 8051 core microcontrollers with native USB 2.0 and Arduino IDE support.

The CH55x is an 8-bit enhanced E8051 core MCU compatible with the MCS51 instruction set. 79% of its instructions are single-byte single-cycle instructions, and the average instruction speed is 8 – 15 times faster than that of the standard MCS51. The special xRAM supports direct memory access (DMA), data fast copy command, and double DPTR pointers. The CH55x has a built-in USB controller and USB transceiver, it supports USB-Host mode and USB-Device mode (all), USB 2.0 full-speed (12Mbps) and low-speed (1.5Mbps) traffic, data packets of up to 64 bytes, and DMA. It has a factory built-in bootloader so firmware can be uploaded directly via USB without the need for an additional programming device.
-Built-in Flash/RAM Built-in 16KB program memory ROM, 256 bytes internal iRAM and 1KB on-chip xRAM, which supports DMA direct memory access
-USB : Embedded USB controller and USB transceiver, supporting USB2.0 full speed and low speed host or device mode. Support up to 64-byte data packet, built-in FIFO, support DMA
-UART: 2 full-duplex asynchronous serial ports, both of them support high baud rate communication. UART0 is a standard MCS51 serial port
-Timer: 3 groups of timers/counters, supporting 2 signal capture and 2 PWM output
-SPI: 1 SPI communication interface, built-in FIFO, support master-slave mode
-ADC: 4-channel 8-bit A/D analog-to-digital converter, supporting voltage comparison
-Touch: 6-channel capacitance detection, supporting up to 15 touch buttons and independent timed interrupt
Go to “Tools” -> “Board” -> “CH55x Boards” and select your chip.
Go to “Tools” and set the desired board options.
Go to “File” -> “Examples” -> “Examples for CH55x Board” and select a Sketch of your choice.

If your board is never used with ch55xduino before, you need to make the ch55x chip enter the bootloader mode. Hold the BOOT button pressed while connecting the board to the USB port of your PC. You do not need to do this if you have installed a blank new chip on the board.
Now you can upload your sketch.

you can also use the Zadig Tool to install the correct driver. Here, click “Options” -> “List All Devices” and select the USB module. Then install the libusb-win32 driver. To do this, the board must be connected and the CH55x must be in bootloader mode.

A brand new chip starts automatically in bootloader mode as soon as it is connected to the PC via USB. Once firmware has been uploaded, the bootloader must be started manually for new uploads. To do this, the board must first be disconnected from the USB port and all voltage sources. Now press the BOOT button and keep it pressed while reconnecting the board to the USB port of your PC. The chip now starts again in bootloader mode, the BOOT button can be released and new firmware can be uploaded within the next couple of seconds.

NCP1207A Offline PWM Controller SMD SOP8

Overview: The NCP1207A/B combines a true current mode modulator and a demagnetization detector to ensure full borderline/critical Conduction Mode in any load/line conditions and minimum drain voltage switching (Quasi-Resonant operation). Due to its inherent skip cycle capability, the controller enters burst mode as soon as the power demand falls below a predetermined level. As this happens at low peak current, no audible noise can be heard. For the NCP1207A, an internal 8.0 micro s timer prevents the free-run frequency to exceed 125 kHz (therefore below the 150 kHz CISPR-22 EMI starting limit), while the skip adjustment capability lets the user select the frequency at which the burst foldback takes place. For the NCP1207B, the internal timer duration is reduced to 4.5 micro s to allow operation at higher frequencies (up to 200 kHz).

The Dynamic Self-Supply (DSS) drastically simplifies the transformer design in avoiding the use of an auxiliary winding to supply the NCP1207A/B. This feature is particularly useful in applications where the output voltage varies during operation (e.g. battery chargers). Due to its high-voltage technology, the IC is directly connected to the high-voltage DC rail. As a result, the short-circuit trip point is not dependent upon any VCC auxiliary level.

The transformer core reset detection is done through an auxiliary winding which, brought via a dedicated pin, also enables fast overvoltage Protection (OVP). Once an OVP has been detected, the IC permanently latches off.
Finally, the continuous feedback signal monitoring implemented with an overcurrent fault protection circuitry (OCP) makes the final design rugged and reliable.

blocks.text: Description: The LM1086 is a regulator with a maximum dropout of 1.5 V at 1.5 A of load current. The device has the same pin-out as TI’s industry standard LM317. Two resistors are required to set the output voltage of the adjustable output voltage version of the LM1086. Typically, no input capacitor is needed unless the device is situated more than 6 inches from the input filter capacitors. Output capacitor can be replaced with ceramic and appropriate ESR. The LM1086 circuit includes a zener trimmed bandgap reference, current limiting, and thermal shutdown. Because the LM1086 regulator is floating and detects only the input-to-output differential voltage, supplies of several hundred volts can be regulated as long as the maximum input-to-output differential is not exceeded. Exceeding the maximum input-to-output deferential will result in short-circuiting the output. By connecting a fixed resistor between the adjustment pin and output, the LM1086 can be also used as a precision current regulator.

The CY8CKIT-049 Prototyping Kits are low cost prototyping platforms for customers wishing to test and develop applications using the PSoC® 4 device family.

The prototyping kits support PC connectivity through the Cypress USB-Serial controller. The devices can be programmed using the USB-Serial controller and the Bootloader Software Host tool. For more information please see the kit user guide attached for steps and examples.
The CY8CKIT-049 is designed to be programmed using the onboard device bootloader through the Cypress USB-Serial device. For information on how to bootload the device please see the kit user guide.

The CY8CKIT-049 Prototyping Kits serve as a low cost alternative to customers looking to sample PSoC 4 devices. The kit provides an open platform and complete access to all of the PSoC 4 device I/O, including default features such as LEDs and a push button. The kit will serve users who are looking to rapidly integrate, develop, and test the PSoC 4 device family with their end design or project.

The CY8CKIT-049 Prototyping kits support both the ARM® 32-bit Cortex-M0™ CY8C41xx and CY8C42xx device families. The PSoC 4 devices are the most reconfigurable ARM based processor providing programmable analog and digital blocks with flexible routing and interconnects. The CY8CKIT-049 Prototyping kits are also CapSense enabled as both the CMOD and CTANK capacitors necessary for CapSense and CapSense Proximity designs are loaded by default.
As always the PSoC 4 device family and the CY8CKIT-049 are supported through the completely free development platform PSoC Creator.

The CY8CKIT-049 provides customers with a USB PC connection using the Cypress USB-Serial device family (CY7C6521x). The device used on the CY8CKIT-049 is the CY7C65211 configurable USB bridge controller. This USB-Serial device supports USB-UART, USB-GPIO, USB-I2C, and USB-SPI configurations. The device family also supports CapSense button control and USB-IF Battery Charging applications. The CY7C65211 device on the CY8CKIT-049 Prototyping kit is by default a USB-UART serial bridge. The USB-Serial device provides USB-UART communication through a COM port and UART bootloading using the Bootloader Host tool included in PSoC Creator. The CY7C65211 is designed to support the PSoC 4 and to be a development platform for USB-Serial users. The USB-Serial portion of the kit can be removed from the PSoC 4 main board by ‘snapping’ the two boards apart along the perforated edge. The USB-Serial board supports open GPIO and serial communication headers for USB-Serial development.

PSoC Creator is an Integrated Design Environment (IDE) which allows concurrent hardware and application firmware design of PSoC 3, PSoC 4, PSoC 4 BLE, PRoC BLE, and PSoC 5LP systems. PSoC systems are designed using classic, familiar schematic capture supported by over 120 pre-verified, production-ready PSoC Components™. To download the latest version of the IDE, please visit the PSoC Creator Page.
To learn more about PSoC Creator and On-Demand trainings, please visit the PSoC Creator Training Page
To learn and train on PSoC, please visit www.cypress.com/go/training
Visit the PSoC 3/4/5 Code Examples page for a list of available PSoC Creator code examples across PSoC Creator, Applications notes and Kits
To get started with PSoC 4, refer to AN79953 – Getting Started with PSoC® 4
To learn more about UART bootloaders, refer to AN68272 – PSoC® 3, PSoC 4 and PSoC 5LP UART Bootloader
For more video tutorials on CY8CKIT-049 click here

PSoC 4 device on-board CY8CKIT-049 includes a UART bootloader for programming through the USB-Serial (USB-UART configuration) controller in the kit. Differences between members of this family are the under-voltage lockout thresholds and maximum duty cycle ranges. The UC1842 and UC1844 have UVLO thresholds of 16 VON and 10 VOFF, ideally suited to off-line applications. The corresponding thresholds for the UC1843 and UC1845 are 8.4 V and 7.6 V. The UC1842 and UC1843 can operate to duty cycles approaching 100%. solderless breadboard consists of a perforated block of plastic with numerous tin plated phosphor bronze or nickel silver alloy spring clips under the perforations.
The clips are often called tie points or contact points. The number of tie points is often given in the specification of the breadboard.
The spacing between the clips (lead pitch) is typically 0.1″ (2.54 mm).
Integrated circuits (ICs) in dual in-line packages (DIPs) can be inserted to straddle the centerline of the block.
Interconnecting wires and the leads of discrete components (such as capacitors, resistors, and inductors) can be inserted into the remaining free holes to complete the circuit.
Where ICs are not used, discrete components and connecting wires may use any of the holes. Typically the spring clips are rated for 1 ampere at 5 volts and 0.333 amperes at 15 volts (5 watts).

makers-510688.summary: Intel P8275 is a programmable CRT controller that buffers memory, generates raster timing, DMA bursts & cursor/light-pen control for microcomputer displays.

blocks.text: Intel P8275 Gain Differential Amplifier 27V 1mA 80KHz IC DIP-40

The 8275 is a single-chip programmable CRT controller designed to interface raster-scan CRT displays with Intel microcomputer systems. It buffers display information from main memory, manages row and character timing, and generates raster timing (horizontal and vertical retrace). By providing two row buffers and programmable counters, the device refreshes the screen while minimizing CPU and DMA overhead, enabling flexible character and screen formats.

The chip supports 1–80 characters per row and 1–64 rows per frame, with programmable lines per character (1–16) and underline placement. It decodes character and field attributes (blink, highlight, reverse video, underline, plus two general-purpose outputs) and provides special control codes (end-of-row, end-of-screen) to reduce memory and DMA traffic. Two 80-character row buffers and two 16-character FIFOs support visible and invisible field-attribute modes.

The 8275 generates DMA requests for burst transfers (1–8 characters per burst) with programmable burst spacing, and signals interrupts at frame boundaries. It exposes a 3-state bidirectional data bus, command/parameter/status registers, light-pen inputs and registers, and cursor control with four cursor formats. The chip requires external dot-timing/dot-clock logic and typically interfaces with standard character generator ROMs; its programmability reduces external hardware and software complexity.

makers-490030.summary: The P6KE440 is a 600W unidirectional TVS diode designed to protect circuits by clamping 440V voltage transients to a safe level with a fast response time.

blocks.text: The P6KE440 is a Transient Voltage Suppressor (TVS) diode engineered to protect sensitive electronic components from damaging voltage transients. As a unidirectional device, it is designed to clamp voltage spikes in one polarity, specifically when a positive voltage surge exceeds the circuit’s normal operating range. Its primary role is to act as a robust electronic shield, diverting excessive transient current away from vulnerable circuits.

When a sudden over-voltage event, such as an electrostatic discharge (ESD) or inductive load switching spike, occurs, the P6KE440 reacts almost instantaneously. It shifts from a high-impedance state to a low-impedance state, effectively clamping the voltage to a safe, predetermined level. This action safely dissipates the high peak pulse energy, rated at 600 watts, through the diode, thereby maintaining the voltage across the protected circuit within its safe operating limits.

Housed in a DO-15 (also known as DO-204AC) package, this diode is physically robust and designed for straightforward PCB mounting. The component is marked for polarity identification, which is crucial for the correct installation of the unidirectional type. It is constructed from materials with a UL 94V-0 flammability rating and is compliant with major industry regulations concerning hazardous substances and supply chain ethics.

makers-489524.summary: The 74HC251 is a high-speed CMOS 8-input digital multiplexer with 3-state outputs. It selects one of eight data lines using a 3-bit address.

blocks.text: 74HC251 74251 Signal Switches, Multiplexers, Decoder IC PDIP-16

The 74HC251 is a high-speed CMOS integrated circuit that functions as an 8-input digital multiplexer. Its primary role is to select one of eight binary data inputs and route it to a single output channel. This data selection is controlled by a 3-bit binary address, making it a fundamental building block for managing multiple data streams in digital systems, effectively acting as a digitally-controlled signal switch.

A key feature of this IC is its provision of both true (Y) and complemented (W) data outputs, offering immediate logic-level flexibility for the selected signal. Furthermore, the outputs are three-state, meaning they can be put into a high-impedance (high-Z) mode. This is controlled by a dedicated Output Enable pin; when this pin is inactive, both outputs disconnect from the internal circuit, allowing multiple devices to be connected to a shared bus without interference.

Fabricated with advanced silicon-gate CMOS technology, the 74HC251 offers the high noise immunity and low power consumption typical of CMOS devices, while achieving speeds comparable to LSTTL logic. It operates over a wide supply voltage range and is designed to interface directly with other CMOS series, as well as NMOS and TTL components, providing versatility in mixed-logic system design.

The IC integrates a BCD code-B decoder, multiplex scan circuitry, segment and digit drivers, and an 8×8 static RAM to store each digit’s data. This chip simplifies LED display control by reducing the number of microcontroller pins needed to drive large displays, providing individual LED segment control, digital and analog brightness adjustment, and a low power shutdown mode that retains data. Its slew-rate limited segment drivers minimize electromagnetic interference, enhancing display quality and reliability. The device is suitable for common-cathode LED configurations. The BC546 is a popular NPN Amplifier transistor that can be found in many audio pre-amplifier designs. The Transistor has a gain value of 800 with a transition frequency of 150MHz, the transistor is also know for its low noise feature.

The BC546 has very low Continuous current of 100mA with a collector to emitter voltage of 65V, hence it cannot be used to switch heavy loads. So it can be used in places where the load current is less than 100mA.

BC546 is a NPN transistor hence the collector and emitter will be left open (Reverse biased) when the base pin is held at ground and will be closed (Forward biased) when a signal is provided to base pin. It is a low current transistor hence the maximum amount of current that could flow through the Collector pin (Ic) is 100mA, hence we cannot connect loads that consume more than 100mA and load voltage more than 30V using this transistor. BC546 has a decent gain value hfe up to 800; this value determines the amplification capacity of the transistor.

When this transistor is fully biased then it can allow a maximum of 100mA to flow across the collector and emitter. This stage is called Saturation Region. When base current is removed the transistor becomes fully off, this stage is called as the Cut-off Region.

The prefix ‘LM’ stands for linear monolithic, referring to the analog components integrated onto a single piece of silicon. The chip consists of two independent, high gain, internally frequency compensated operational amplifiers which were designed specifically to operate from a single power supply over a wide range of voltages. Operation from split power supplies is also possible and the low power supply current drain is independent of the magnitude of the power supply voltage.

blocks.text: The 4094 IC 8-Stage Serial Shift Register DIP-16 is a versatile CMOS logic integrated circuit designed to perform efficient serial-to-parallel data shifting and storage in digital systems. 2N5401 is a PNP transistor designed specifically for high voltage – low power switching applications and amplifications. The NPN complementary for the device is 2N5551 and is available in TO-92
2N5401 has three pins like any other transistor namely EMITTER, BASE and COLLECTOR.

blocks.v: Emitter · Current flows in to the device through this pin
Base · Base is used for triggering transistor ON and OFF
Collector · Current flows out of this pin

blocks.text: With DC Current Gain (hFE) up to 100
Maximum voltage across collector and emitter: 150V
Maximum voltage across collector and base: 160 V
Maximum voltage across base and emitter: 5V

2N5401 is specifically designed to be used in high voltage applications where load consumes very less power (i.e. Current drawn by load is low). These types of circuits can be seen in telephone systems. It can also be used when you want a simple switching device for high voltage loads. Also the component is cheap and easy to work with.
2N5401 can be used like any general purpose PNP transistor but for sake of understanding the device working let us consider a simple application circuit as shown below.

In the above circuit we are using 2N5401 as a simple switching device and the switching load being small DC motor. The button here is for providing the trigger to the transistor and 10KΩ resistor is for limiting the current to base and to avoid breaching maximum voltage allowed at the base. Also as pointed in the comment section belwo, considering the low gain of this transistor, it might be a better idea to use a low value resistor like 100R for R1 to allow more base current. The circuit is powered from a negative voltage source of -5V DC as shown in diagram.
Before going for working let us revise the typical characteristics of a PNP transistor:
The device does not conduct when the current does not flow out of the base of the transistor or the device conducts only when the base current that flows out of the device reaches a threshold.
The current flow through collector is determined by the base current to a certain point. So with higher the gate current we have lower conduction resistance and higher the collector current.
The PNP transistor conducts only when a threshold current flows out the base, so the instant the base current reaches zero the device stops conducting.

Consider the button is not pressed: When the button is not pressed there will be no base current and with no base current the transistor will not conduct based on the characteristics of PNP transistor. When the transistor does not conduct the entire voltage appears across it and the motor will be OFF.

Consider the button is pressed: When the button is pressed, the base of 2N5401 will be connected to negative power supply and so there will be a path for the current flow. When the base current flows out from the device it will start conducting as stated in characteristics. In the presence of this collector current flow a voltage appears across the motor connected in series with collector pin. In the presence of the voltage the motor will start rotating and it will stay like that until the button is released. The moment the button is released the base current will reaches zero, there by turning OFF the transistor and the motor.
In this way we can turn motor ON and OFF by using simple button as a trigger and 2N5401 as switching device. In high speed switching the trigger is provided by microcontroller instead of button.

باور بانك هيريجو اتش ار ٠١٤ هو شاحن متنقل متعدد الاستخدامات يجمع بين الشحن السريع، والكابلات المدمجة، والشاشة الرقمية، ولمبة خارجية مدمجة في جهاز واحد عملي. يأتي بسعة ١٠٠٠٠ ملي أمبير، ويدعم الشحن السريع حتى ٢٢.٥ وات للأجهزة المتوافقة، مع إمكانية شحن عدة أجهزة في نفس الوقت ضمن حدود الخرج الكلي المدعوم.

هذا الموديل مناسب للاستخدام اليومي والسفر والرحلات والطوارئ، لأنه لا يقتصر على شحن الموبايل فقط، بل يحتوي أيضًا على لمبة خارجية مدمجة يمكن الاستفادة منها في التخييم، أو أثناء انقطاع الكهرباء، أو عند الحاجة لإضاءة إضافية في مكان مظلم. وجود كابلات مدمجة من أكثر من نوع يقلل الحاجة لحمل كابلات كثيرة، ويجعل الباور بانك جاهزًا للاستخدام مع أنواع مختلفة من الأجهزة.

طبقًا للصور والبيانات المرسلة، يحتوي المنتج على كابلات مدمجة تشمل تايب سي ولايتنينج وميكرو وكابل عادي، بالإضافة إلى مخارج علوية متعددة. كما يحتوي على شاشة رقمية ذكية تعرض نسبة البطارية المتبقية، مما يساعدك على متابعة مستوى الشحن بدقة قبل الخروج أو أثناء السفر. يدعم المنتج شحن حتى خمسة أجهزة في نفس الوقت طبقًا للبيانات المرسلة، مع ملاحظة أن سرعة الشحن تتأثر بعدد الأجهزة المتصلة وإجمالي القدرة المتاحة.

blocks.text: MaAnt Dianba Mini+ 100W 8-Port Desktop Fast Charging Station

MaAnt Dianba Mini+ 100W 8-Port Desktop Fast Charging Station is a compact professional multi-device charging hub designed for technicians, mobile repair shops, offices, homes, and workbenches that need to charge several devices at the same time from one organized desktop unit. It combines multiple USB-A ports with dedicated QC and PD fast charging ports, giving users a practical charging station for phones, tablets, accessories, testing devices, and daily electronic equipment.

The MaAnt Dianba Mini+ charger is built as a powerful desktop fast charging station with a total power capability of up to 100W. It is designed to charge up to 8 devices together, helping reduce cable clutter and avoid using many separate wall chargers. This makes it especially useful for mobile maintenance desks, service centers, shops, offices, family use, and any place where several devices need stable charging at the same time.

The front panel includes multiple labeled ports, including standard USB-A charging ports and dedicated fast charging ports for QC and PD compatible devices. The images show a clear port layout with six USB-A style outputs, one QC fast charging port, and one PD port, giving a total of eight charging channels. The PD/QC fast charging section supports up to 20W according to the supplied product images, while the full station total power is rated up to 100W.

A built-in LED digital display allows the user to monitor charging status more clearly. The display can show real-time information such as voltage, current, and power status for connected channels. This is particularly useful in repair environments where technicians may need to watch device charging behavior during testing or battery recovery operations.

Safety is a key part of this charger design. The supplied product images mention 8 layers of protection, including overvoltage protection, overcurrent protection, overheat protection, short-circuit protection, overload protection, overpower protection, anti-interference protection, and electrostatic discharge protection. The body is described as made from fire-retardant and high-temperature resistant materials, making it suitable for continuous desktop use when operated correctly.

The compact mini design saves workspace area while keeping charging cables in one place. Instead of using many adapters across the desk, the MaAnt Dianba Mini+ can act as one central charging hub for smartphones, tablets, wireless earbuds, power banks, service devices, and compatible electronic accessories. Its organized port layout and intelligent power management make it a practical choice for professional and everyday use.

شاحن ما آنت ديانبا ميني بلس بقدرة ١٠٠ وات و٨ مخارج هو محطة شحن مكتبية متعددة المخارج مصممة لشحن عدة أجهزة في نفس الوقت بطريقة منظمة وآمنة. يناسب فنيين صيانة الموبايل، مكاتب العمل، المنازل، مراكز الخدمة، ومحطات الاختبار التي تحتاج إلى شاحن واحد قوي بدل استخدام عدد كبير من الشواحن المنفصلة على نفس المكتب.

تم تصميم شاحن ما آنت ديانبا ميني بلس ليعمل كمحطة شحن مكتبية قوية بقدرة إجمالية تصل إلى ١٠٠ وات. يحتوي على ٨ مخارج شحن، مما يسمح بتوصيل عدة هواتف أو تابلت أو إكسسوارات إلكترونية في نفس الوقت. هذا التصميم يقلل الفوضى الناتجة عن كثرة الشواحن والكابلات، ويجعل مكان العمل أكثر تنظيمًا، خصوصًا داخل محلات الصيانة ومكاتب الفنيين.

blocks.text: Arduino Starter KIT Arduino Learning Kit UNO R3 SMD KIT Upgraded Version for Arduino Starter Kit AK6
Arduino UNO R3 SMD Starter Kit AK6 Advanced Learning Kit

The Arduino UNO R3 SMD Starter Kit AK6 is an all-in-one educational and project-building kit created for users who want to learn Arduino programming through practical experiments. It is suitable for beginners, students, hobbyists, and training labs that need a balanced collection of commonly used modules and components in one organized package.

At the center of the kit is the Arduino UNO R3 SMD board, which offers the same general functionality and compatibility expected from a standard UNO R3 platform, while using the SMD version of the main microcontroller. This makes the kit a strong choice for Arduino learning, sensor interfacing, digital and analog experiments, display control, alarm projects, motor driving, and access control demonstrations.

Based on the product image, the AK6 kit includes a broad range of components that help users explore many important Arduino concepts. It contains basic electronic parts such as LEDs, resistors, push buttons, breadboard, jumper wires, and header strips, making it easy to begin with simple circuits like LED blinking, button input, and basic signal control. These core parts are essential for understanding wiring, prototyping, and breadboard-based circuit building.

The kit also includes several sensor and input modules for interactive projects. From the image, these include a DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor, sound sensor module, flame sensor, water level sensor, infrared receiver, joystick module, matrix keypad, LDR photoresistors, and a rotary potentiometer. With these parts, users can create projects that react to light, heat, humidity, sound, water presence, user input, and infrared remote commands.

For display and output applications, the AK6 kit provides multiple useful modules such as an LCD1602 display (Not Soldered), 4-digit 7-segment display, 8×8 LED dot matrix, single 7-segment display, RGB LED or RGB module, standard LEDs in multiple colors, an active buzzer, and a passive buzzer. These components support projects like counters, mini user interfaces, status displays, alarms, scrolling patterns, and visual output demonstrations.

The image also shows motion and control hardware including a micro servo motor, 5V stepper motor, and its matching ULN2003 driver board, making the kit useful for robotics basics, motion control experiments, rotating mechanisms, and small automation systems. In addition, the presence of an RFID module with RFID card and key tag enables users to build entry systems, identification projects, and smart interaction demos.

Another practical advantage of this AK6 version is that it appears to come in a storage case, helping keep the components organized and easier to store after use. This makes it convenient for classrooms, home learning, workshops, and personal project benches.

Overall, the Arduino UNO R3 SMD Starter Kit AK6 is a versatile and beginner-friendly kit that combines core electronic components with popular modules used in real Arduino practice. It provides a strong foundation for learning coding, circuit assembly, interfacing, sensing, control, and prototyping in one package.

blocks.text: FQPF9N60 (FQPF9N60C) N-Channel Power MOSFET – 600V 9A (TO-220F Full Pack)

The FQPF9N60 (often listed as FQPF9N60C) is an N-channel enhancement mode power MOSFET engineered for high-voltage, high-speed switching applications. It is widely used in power stages where efficient switching, stable thermal performance, and reliable operation are required—such as SMPS power supplies, DC-DC converters, and motor control circuits.

Rated for a 600V drain-source voltage (VDSS) and a continuous drain current of 9A, this MOSFET is a practical choice for high-voltage switching designs. The device is commonly offered in a TO-220F Full Pack package, which provides built-in insulation, making mounting and heatsink installation safer and more convenient while supporting effective thermal management.

Its electrical behavior is optimized for switching efficiency, with characteristics typically associated with low gate charge and low on-resistance, helping reduce both switching and conduction losses in real-world applications.

تدعم هذه القطعة جهدًا حتى ٦٠٠ فولت مع تيار تشغيل يصل إلى ٩ أمبير، ما يجعلها مناسبة لعديد من مراحل التبديل ذات الجهد العالي. كما أنها تأتي غالبًا في تغليف تي أو ٢٢٠ اف المعزول، وهو تغليف يوفر عزلًا مدمجًا يساعد على تركيبها على المبدد الحراري بأمان وبسهولة مع تحسين إدارة الحرارة.
وتُعد خيارًا عمليًا عند الحاجة إلى موسفت يتحمل الجهد العالي ويقدم كفاءة تبديل جيدة في دوائر القدرة.

blocks.text: Wago LT-223-4 Panel Mount Wire Connector 4 In 4 Out – Spring Clamp Cable Terminal
Wago LT-223-4 Panel Mount Wire Connector 4 In 4 Out

The LT-223-4 Panel Mount Wire Connector is a practical and efficient wiring solution designed for organized cable connection inside electrical panels, control cabinets, lighting systems, and compact installation spaces. With its 4 input and 4 output configuration, this connector allows multiple wires to be connected in a clean and structured way, making it ideal for parallel wiring and neat distribution layouts.

This model uses a spring clamp connection mechanism, which makes installation much easier compared to traditional screw terminals. Wires can be inserted and secured quickly without twisting or soldering, helping reduce installation time and making maintenance or rewiring more convenient. The spring contact system also helps provide stable electrical performance and reliable wire holding during long-term use.

Its panel mount design makes it especially suitable for applications where the connector needs to remain fixed in place inside equipment, enclosures, or distribution systems. This gives the installation a more professional and organized appearance, while also helping improve wiring stability in vibrating or frequently serviced environments.

The housing is made from flame-retardant polycarbonate, providing good insulation strength and durability for electrical use. The internal contact parts are made from copper alloy with tin plating, helping support dependable conductivity and long-term connection reliability. The connector is also reusable, allowing wires to be removed and reconnected when needed.

Because it combines multiple connection points, quick spring-clamp operation, and panel-mount convenience, the LT-223-4 is suitable for electricians, installers, maintenance technicians, panel builders, and workshop users looking for a reliable and space-saving wiring solution.

يعتمد هذا الموصل على آلية تثبيت زنبركية تساعد على توصيل الأسلاك بسرعة وسهولة مقارنة بوسائل التوصيل التقليدية المعتمدة على المسامير. يمكن إدخال السلك وتثبيته مباشرة بدون لف أو لحام، وهو ما يسهّل التركيب ويوفر وقت العمل، كما يجعل أعمال الفك وإعادة التوصيل والصيانة أكثر راحة وسرعة. ويساعد نظام التثبيت الداخلي أيضًا على توفير ضغط ثابت على السلك للحصول على اتصال كهربائي مستقر وموثوق.

ومن أهم مميزات هذا المنتج أنه مصمم للتثبيت على اللوحة، لذلك فهو مناسب جدًا للوحات التحكم، وصناديق الكهرباء، وأنظمة الإضاءة، ووحدات التوزيع، والتوصيلات داخل الأجهزة والمعدات المختلفة. هذا النوع من التثبيت يساهم في تحسين شكل التوصيلات، وزيادة ثباتها، وتنظيم مسار الأسلاك داخل النظام بشكل أفضل.

جسم الموصل مصنوع من بولي كربونات مقاوم للاشتعال، وهي خامة مناسبة للاستخدام الكهربائي وتساعد على توفير مستوى جيد من الأمان والمتانة. أما الجزء الموصل الداخلي فهو مصنوع من سبيكة نحاسية مطلية بالقصدير لدعم جودة التوصيل وثبات الأداء. كما أن الموصل قابل لإعادة الاستخدام، مما يجعله مناسبًا للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى تعديل أو إعادة توصيل في وقت لاحق.

إذا كنت تحتاج إلى موصل أسلاك سريع وآمن ومنظم لتوصيل أربعة خطوط دخول وأربعة خطوط خروج داخل لوحة أو صندوق كهربائي، فإن إل تي 223-4 يقدم حلًا عمليًا ومريحًا يجمع بين سهولة الاستخدام وثبات التوصيل والحجم المناسب.

blocks.text: This is a compact MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking) solar charge controller module designed for charging single-cell 3.7V Li-ion or LiPo batteries (e.g., 18650) at a constant current/constant voltage (CC/CV) profile. It accepts an input voltage of 4.4–6 V from a solar panel or 5V USB supply and provides a regulated 4.2 V output at up to 1 A charging current.

The MPPT algorithm dynamically adjusts the input impedance to extract maximum power from the solar panel, improving charging efficiency compared to linear regulators. The module is small (18×10.16×2.7 mm) and lightweight, making it suitable for portable solar projects. It features overcharge protection and is compatible with 18650 cells and other 3.7V Li-ion batteries.

3duino-8122.summary: Get started with electronics using the Arduino Uno R3 with Cable . Featuring the ATmega328P microcontroller, 14 digital I/O pins, 6 analog inputs, and full Arduino IDE compatibility, it’s perfect for robotics, IoT, automation, and DIY projects.

blocks.text: This is the Arduino Uno R3 . In addition to all the features of the previous board, the Uno now uses an ATmega16U2 instead of the 8U2 found on the Uno (or the FTDI found on previous generations). This allows for faster transfer rates and more memory. No drivers needed for Linux or Mac (inf file for Windows is needed and included in the Arduino IDE), and the ability to have the Uno show up as a keyboard, mouse, joystick, etc.

The Uno R3 also adds SDA and SCL pins next to the AREF. In addition, there are two new pins placed near the RESET pin. One is the IOREF that allow the shields to adapt to the voltage provided from the board. The other is a not connected and is reserved for future purposes. The Uno R3 works with all existing shields but can adapt to new shields which use these additional pins.

The Arduino Uno Egypt is a microcontroller board based on the ATmega328. Arduino is an open-source, prototyping platform and its simplicity makes it ideal for hobbyists to use as well as professionals. The Arduino Uno has 14 digital input/output pins (of which 6 can be used as PWM outputs), 6 analog inputs, a 16 MHz crystal oscillator, a USB connection, a power jack, an ICSP header, and a reset button. It contains everything needed to support the microcontroller; simply connect it to a computer with a USB cable or power it with a AC-to-DC adapter or battery to get started.

The Arduino Uno differs from all preceding boards in that it does not use the FTDI USB-to-serial driver chip. Instead, it features the Atmega8U2 microcontroller chip programmed as a USB-to-serial converter.

“Uno” means one in Italian and is named to mark the upcoming release of Arduino 1.0. The Arduino Uno and version 1.0 will be the reference versions of Arduno, moving forward. The Uno is the latest in a series of USB Arduino boards, and the reference model for the Arduino platform.
The Arduino open-sourced IDE drivers can be downloaded for free and we have created a download and installation tutorial for the Windows XP platform.
